notes.title: Updates
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Here are what we've been working on:

-New Level generator with more capabilities such as procedural terrains. Anord will have playable levels with procedurally generated terrains. So expect levels that take place in forests, mountains. 
Also levels that have internal spaces (buildings and such) have been upgraded with more capabilities as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37544798/a0db2b0c8b612a35be62752225fe2fe95f2c81bf.gif[/img]

-We've re-worked the inventory system. New system supports items with different sizes. So inventory management is a thing now.
It is also compatible with gamepads

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37544798/29fb6c008327c9860a8eea72acb0a08e95f5872e.gif[/img]

-We've a new internal tool for Anord now. Besides its many uses this tool allows us automate game builds. Which means we'll be able to deliver faster once Anord is out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37544798/804ab3abf4233d188420f1395027d6d4a4eae92b.jpg[/img]

-We've added inventory item crafting.
-Re-designed upgrade system
-Re-designed main menu
-Input customization and binding is in.
-Localization system is in.

We'll post more announcements on those features.

Also we'll put out a demo once we're satisfied with what we have.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: UI - Gamepad and Demo
notes.content:
Hi ya!

We've been busy with UI code and graphics + adding support for gamepads.

We have several different types of in-game User Interface in Anord.

-Informational UIs help with the lore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37544798/0b0ee3e6b05098ea7d0e332837a1456128ed4472.gif[/img]

-Vendor and Loot UIs let use buy/sell items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37544798/92f9e72a85beced6fc107805b47699bef9b09861.gif[/img]

-UI for Moving Platforms that have interaction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37544798/38ad4814fc84460035b2e7d40e62830335bfd337.gif[/img]

-UI for Weapon Crafting is where you open weapon component slots and attach a dropped weapon to component to it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37544798/983cb9c41bbe5969a062d681a9b94a2f34843748.gif[/img]

- Upgrades UI is where you use your hard earned XP to power up your character.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37544798/04da6e6b00700dfed8ef1c443ce20d195a59a53f.gif[/img]

beside those we also have Inventory, Minimap and some smaller ones.

Gamepads are a thing now. It needs a bit more testing but it is in at the moment.

We want to release a demo in the coming month and get some feedback from everyone. Not to mention we're extremely excited about that!

See you all in the next announcement!

notes.content:

We've been working hard on this update.
On the visual/audial side we've added footstep, bullet impact, headshot sound and particle effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37544798/e973aeeeafce4e3a48bcdccff24c354c23c15b89.gif[/img]

notes.title: New Player Animations and Stun
notes.content:
Hello once more!

This weeks update is pretty big. We started changing the Player Character' movement animations and added new abilities as well!
You can now use Wall Cling, Wall Jump and Ledge Hang!
All of those make traversing a level much smooth and also gives a more action packed combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37544798/9f2cf1ba65701ff1c2c84eb12e42b79bc9c7f54d.gif[/img]

You can now stun enemies!
When an enemy is stunned Player can get close to that enemy and perform "Stun Attack".
We'll be adding the various Stun Attack animations in coming weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37544798/16c710acccec6a59fdf48096d8101f672989efa0.gif[/img]

Also in the works for the next update: Sound and particle effects for Player animations.

See you in the next update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37544798/42ec863c8cb4b772fbc4ec8c26511e597548de19.gif[/img]

Coming up next, we want to show the Combat finisher / Stun attack feature.

See you in a bit.

notes.title: Procedural Levels in Anord
notes.content:
Hey ya!
We've been working so hard for this feature. It is somehow big for us.
Anord will have procedurally generated levels while keeping all of its current features.
We can generate levels with locks and doors, can increase number of enemies as you progress in a level, can have main and alternate paths. 
All the previous features like ladders, elevators, random loot, changing Time of Day-Weather, Minimap...etc  currently stays.
We're still working on having Teleporters on levels.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37544798/35a889b42a178a8d95d1e80258d68898485c792a.gif[/img]


Also we've changed many things regarding weapons. 
No more ammo drops, weapons generate their own ammo.
Weapons have durability. It effects weapons damage and can be fixed from a Weapon Station.

Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Come Join Anord Alpha Test
notes.content:
Apply Now to Join the Anord Alpha Test and Assist the Developers!

Anord's development has greatly advanced and now is the right time to engage the community in the development process to achieve a fun game.

We are looking for active community members who would like to help us with the development of Anord and to take part in the first public alpha testing.

As an alpha tester you will receive:
[list]
[*] Anord Alpha Test Key.
[*] Access to private testers only Discord channels, where you can freely discuss, share any thoughts, and share in-game materials with other testers.
[*] Those who will provide very valuable feedback will gain access to early versions of post-release patches and will be able to further assist future development of Anord.
[/list]

If you want to participate, please fill out the following form. You have until Sunday 31/12/2020 23:59 CET to apply. Based on the answers we will choose our new alpha testers.

Apply now: https://forms.gle/uK1vvWKTCLAvpUXi8

notes.content:

We were trying to change how AI Agents move through levels for a long time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37544798/3db2ed6ded3e3639ab1829b94e51f6b05e039b2e.gif[/img]

notes.title: Main Menu + New AI + Save System...
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
Lots of things have changed:

[list]
[*] We added new options to the main menu for customization and for preparation for the "Input Customization".
[*] New AI is still going on. It has improved too much from the previous iteration. AI will be able use ladders and jump up/down if everything goes as planned.
[*] We started on the Save System as well. We are still considering if we should add "Save Slots" or not but other than that Player / Dialogue / Quest / Inventory can be saved at the moment. We still got some work on the Loading part though.
[*] We managed to do a project wide structural change which will let us testing and finding bugs faster.
[*] Lots and lots of bug fixes.
[*] We started our social networks for better communication. Made a huge face lift-up to Steam Store page.
[/list]

We're aiming to update the demo with all the new features. This will be huge for us.
There are so many things we'd like to show to you.

notes.title: Fog of War + Chests + new AI tests
notes.content:
Hi,
Here is what we worked on for the past week:

-Fog of War system: We now have a Work in Progress Fog of War system. Currently, only Player's Field of Vision has color and rest of the screen will have darker / de-saturated image. We'll like to build on this idea and try a few things. More on this next week!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37544798/1a5df024f7b6fe280e3e82a0369bed59cb6d145e.gif[/img]



-New Chest system: There were some problems with our chest systems. While fixing those, we also made a clear path for upcoming "Stash" and "Vendor" systems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37544798/2c25c23f74b12c3e008d71bfbf8e9ee2ef817af3.gif[/img]

-We're also working on a new AI system as well. If goes well, We'll be using Finite State Machine in our AI code instead of a Behavior Tree implementation. This'll give us more freedom and speed while adding more AI types. More on this next week

notes.title: UI changes and Abilities
notes.content:
Hi,
This week we've changed the Ability System in the game quite a bit.

Player can choose between 3 Exo-Skeletons. (only one will be available in Early Access)
In full game, once an Exo-Skeleton is unlocked, players will be able to change their Exo-Skeleton from the Players Upgrade Panel. 

Each Exo-Skeleton has its own set of Active Abilities.(8 for each at the moment)
Players will be able to assign 4 of those Active Abilities to buttons.

All Exo-Skeletons share a Passive Ability Tree.
Every node in Passive Ability Tree adds several stats to the player.
There are 40+ stats and 34 Passive Ability nodes at the moment (subject to change)

Work in Progress Passive Ability Tree
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37544798/983c71a3328094543efa15bd440370f2060e88ad.gif[/img]


When you level-up you gain Passive Ability Points and unlock Active Abilities.

On top of all those class customizations, we also have weapon and exo-skeleton components.
So there'll be quite a few ways to customize your gameplay :)

We also made a small addition to AI. 
AI now staggers (short animation) if it gets damaged from its Health.
Damages to a shield do not stagger AIs.

notes.title: Lots of guns
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

This week we've added:

-[u]Weapons:[/u] Handguns, rifles, shotguns, grenades, launchers, melee weapons to the project. There are total of 37 weapons in now. We still need to test those more but we'll try to make all those weapons available at full release.
-[u]Weapon Components:[/u] Most weapons have "Weapon component slots" in Anord. You can attach a component to the barrel, muzzle, grip, stock, magazine and side of a weapon (if it has an available slot). We've added 61 weapon component slots to the project. Again those need testing and will be available at the full release.
-[u]Player Upgrades UI:[/u] We're now able to assign abilities to Ability slots.
-[u]AI:[/u] AI can change its weapon. For example: If player is close, AI can chose to use a melee weapon now.

Cheers everyone :)

notes.title: ANORD Demo (alpha-5)
notes.content:
Anord is a single-player 2.5D Sci-fi Action RPG Platformer set in a post war era.
It has horror elements and tough boss fights only suitable for brave souls.
You play as a cyborg, made to infiltrate enemy fronts at any cost.
You can customize your character’s abilities and play-style by leveling your character.

Anord Demo is not perfect. It needs some love, fixes and improvements but we still wanted to show what the game is about so you get the look and feel of what is coming.

Demo shows:
[list]
[*] First level of the full game
[*] 3 Work in progress AI enemies (Anything might happen :)
[*] Player Upgrade UI
[*] Inventory UI
[*] Time of Day and Seasons system
[/list]

There are more features already built-in like: NPC interactions, Weapon customization, Enemy health bars... but we had to disable some for the demo. 
We want to update the demo and enable those features in coming months.
